book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Ruuka

content: Ekimweeso kyo omutuumba
Eriibhaga rino Yeesu yaari mwiiseengerero, akabharora abhaniibhi bharatuura ebhimweeso bhyaabhu muhuunguro ye ekimweeso.
Akamurora kweeki omutuumba owumwe omutaka arateemu amazeenzere abhiri ego.
Niho Yeesu akabhuga, “Ndabhabhuurira ge eheene kubha, omutuumba omutaka wuyo, atuuriri eziimbirya nzaru muhuunguro kukira bhoosi.
Bhoosi bhano bhatuuriri ebhimweeso bhisuuhu ego kubhyaaru bhye ebhigiro bhyaabhu. Nawe omutuumba wuno ni mutaka bhukongʼu, neewe atuuriri bhyoosi bhino yaari kwiisigira mubhwiikari bhwaaye.”
Yeesu araroota okugwiisibhwa kwe eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya

Abhaanabheega abhaandi, bhaari bharakeerenerya eriiseengerero, kyeego ekangʼatibhwa kwa amagina amazomu, hamwe ne ebhigiro bhyo obhuguri bhino abhaatu bhaamuruusiirye Taatabhugya. Nawe Yeesu akabhuga,
“Gayo goosi gano mukugarora, ziraaza eziisiku zino ritariho eriigina rino riraatame iguru we eriindi, goosi garagwiisibhwa!”
Yeesu araroota iguru ye enyaako ya abhaanabheega bhaaye
Abhaanabheega bhayo bhakamubhuurya, “Omweegya, amangʼana gayo ni ryoori garaatuuke? Ne ekyeerekenioki kireerekye kubha, gayo gari haguhi kutuukira?”

Akabhabhuurira, “Mwiiriihe, omuutu wowoosi ataaza kubhangʼeena! Abhaatu bhaaru bharaaza bhakuhokeerya eriina ryaane, bharabhuga, ‘Enye neenye Masiya.’ Kweeki bharabhuga, ‘Eriibhaga ryo obhuteero, rihikiri!’ Abhaatu bhayo, bharangʼeena abhaatu bhaaru.
Na hano mukwiigwa amangʼana ge eriihi, ne ebhitiika bhya abhabhisa, mutoobhoha. Gareenderwa gayo goosi, gatuuke hiinga, nawe obhuteero bhwa goosi, bhukyaari.”
Yeesu akagaamba, “Ekyaaro kimwe kirarwaana ne ekiindi, no obhutemi obhumwe bhurarwaana no obhutemi obhuundi.

Harabhaho ebhirigito ebhikuru bhye esi, na ahagiro ahaandi harabha ne enzara ehaari, na amarweeri amabhi bhukongʼu. Na kiraaza ekyeerekenio ekikuru kurwa mwiisaaro, na abhaatu bhararora ebhisigo bhyo okubhobhohya bhukongʼu.

“Nawe, hano gayo goosi gakyaari kutuuka, abhaatu bharabhagwaata emwe no okubhahira muziinyuumba zye eziisaango, no okubhabhoha munyuumba ya abhabhohwa, bharabhanyaakya. Na murahirwa embere ya abhatemi na abhaanaangwa, kwo okubha emwe ni abhaanabheega bhaane.
Niigo ego muraabhone omweeya gwo okunigaambira.
“Kweego, mwaamure muziikoro zyeenyu, okubha mutige okunyaaka murakyoorabhwi hano ekiina kyeenyu kikubha kikyaari okugaambwa.
Enye omweene, ndabhaha amangʼeeni na amangʼana gano muraagaambe, tee abhabhisa bheenyu bhatakunagya kwaanga naabhe okubhahakania.

“Eriibhaga riyo ryo okuruusibhwa kwa abhakaangati, murariibhwa omukoonyo na abhiibhuri bheenyu, abhahiiri bheenyu, abhaatu bho orugaanda rweenyu, na abhasaani bheenyu. Bharakora abhaandi bheenyu bhariitwa.
Abhaatu bhoosi bharabhabhiihirirya kwe ekigirye kyo okubha emwe ni bhaanabheega bhaane.
Nawe, rutakubhura naabhe oruzweeri orumwe kumitwe gyeenyu!
No omuutu wowoosi wuno araagumire tee obhuteero niwe araatuuribhwe.
Yeesu araroota kubha Yerusaremu erasikibhwa
“Hano muraarore kubha omugye gwa Yerusaremu gwiinaarirwe na abhasirikare bhe eriihi, niho muraamenye kubha eriibhaga ryo obhusarya rihikiri.
Eriibhaga riyo, bhano bhakwiikara mukyaaro kya Yudea, bhangʼosere mubhiguru, na bhano bhakubha mumugye gwa Yerusaremu, bharwemu bhwaangu, na bhano bhakubha mumiguundu, bhatakyoora mumugye muyo.
Bhararyaara, kwo okubha eziisiku ziyo ni siku zye enyaako, okubha amangʼana goosi gano gakaamirwe gakuunaane

Turabharorera ebhigoongi, abhakari bhano bharitohiri na bhano bhakukookya muziisiku ziyo! Erabha bhubhi, kwo okubha, mukyaaro muyo, harabha ne enyaako ehaari bhukongʼu, kweeki obhutemwa okurwa ku Taatabhugya bhuraaza kubhaatu.

Abhaatu abhaandi, bhariitwa kwa nyaambato, na abhaandi, bharagwaatwa no okubha abhabhohwa no okuhirwa mubhyaaro ebhiindi bhyoosi. No omugye gwa Yerusaremu ogweene, guratazwa na abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro ebhiindi bhano bhatari Abhayahudi, tee eziisiku zyaabhu zisire.
Omwaana wo Omuutu araaza kutuurya abhaatu bhaaye
“Erabha ekyeerekenio kuryoobha, omweeri ne eziinzota. Na mukyaaro hano, eziinyaanza zirabha na amabhooka maaru, ziraruma, na kuteemo yiyo, abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro bharabha ne ehaha ne enyaako.

Gayo goosi, hano gakuuza kukyaaro, abhaatu bharoobhoha bhukongʼu. Bharakwa eziikoro kwo okukaangwa, bharaganya okubhonwa na amangʼana amabhi mukyaaro, kwo okubha Taatabhugya arabhisiingisya ebhigiro bhyoosi bhya mwiisaaro.
“Niho, abhaatu bhoosi bharaandore Omwaana wo Omuutu, nikuuza mumasaaro kwo obhuturo bhwaaru no obhuguungo.
Gayo goosi, hano garaataange okukorwa, mwiimeerere tiri, kwo okubha eriibhaga ryo okutuuribhwa kweenyu, riri haguhi!”
Ekireengyo kyo okwiisuka kwo obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya
Kweeki, Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye ekireengyo, arabhuga, “Mwiiseege omuti gwo omutiini, ne emiti egiindi gyoosi.
Hano muraarore gitaangiri okusibhuka amatu, hayohayo muramenya kubha eriibhaga rya amaahu riisukiri.
“Egoego na neemwe, hano muraarore gayo gataangiri kukorwa, niho muraamenye kubha obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya bhwiisukiri.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, orwiibhuro runo rutakuhita, tee gano goosi garaamarwe kukorwa.
Eriisaaro ne ekyaaro bhirahweerera, nawe amangʼana gaane gatakuhweerera na rumwe!
Mubhe meeso
“Mwiiriihe, mutaaza kuhizwa na amangʼana amabhi ne ebhigiro bhye ekyaaro, no obhunywi, ne ehaha yo obhwiikari. Eraabhe mutiiriihiri, orusiku rwo obhuteero rurabha kituukiro no okubhakaanga.
Orusiku ruyo, rurabha kituukiro mukyaaro kyoosi.
Kweego, mubhe meeso eriibhaga ryoosi! Mugeenderere kumusabha Taatabhugya, okubha mutuuribhwe mugoosi gano garaatuuke, no okwiimeerera embere ya Omwaana wo Omuutu.”
Kuziisiku ziyo, mumwiisi Yeesu ahaabha areegya abhaatu mwiigoobhe rye eriiseengerero, nawe obhutiku ahaabha aragya mukiguru kino kikubhirikirwa Ekiguru kye Emizeituni.
Eziisiku zyoosi, abhaatu bhoosi bhahaabhuuka etabhoori zuri, no okwiikumanirya mwiiseengerero bhamwiitegeerere.
